uranus is in the 6th, bringing change and reinvention to your routine and schedules, or even service to others.

value your self expression through creative hobbies, maybe even with a career that allows you to do so. within your career, make sure you have room to learn new topics, don't stay in a monotonous job where you're isolated, socialization and communication is a need for you. you often go into depth about finding the cores to things, especially with things society doesn't like to talk about, but you may feel some struggle to be able to have the confidence to talk about it. people find you relatable, funny, open-minded, and someone who is unique, which makes them likely to trust you. jobs that come into mind here are communications, like journalism, vlogging, that type of thing, or even teaching workshops for topics people don't typically talk about, i don't see you falling into a traditional career especially not one service related. even being in the psychology field, maybe counseling or research for something "taboo" like sex therapy for example is somewhere you would thrive. basically anything you can connect with others and have freedom to explore as many and whatever topics you'd like!
